name: InterContinental Cairo Semiramis
positioning: High-rise InterContinental hotel facing the Nile in the heart of Cairo, near the Egyptian Museum and Cairo Opera House
best_for: Travelers who want a central Nile-side base near the Egyptian Museum
Couples and families planning a wedding or large celebration in Cairo

facts.text: The hotel is named for the Assyrian queen Semiramis.
The hotel is a high-rise with hanging gardens.
The hotel is in the heart of Cairo.
The hotel is near the Egyptian Museum and the Cairo Opera House.
Rooms with balconies have modern French decor.
Rooms have Elemis or L'Occitane bathroom amenities.
The hotel's restaurants offer a variety of cuisines, from Lebanese to Italian to French.
Rithmo, entered through Arabian Nights-style doors, serves late-night cocktails.
The hotel offers several wedding venues that draw on the heritage of the region.
The hotel has banquet and meeting venues ranging from intimate boardrooms to grand ballrooms.
Wi-Fi access is available throughout the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel faces the Nile, near the Egyptian Museum and the Cairo Opera House.
Named for the Assyrian queen Semiramis, the hotel is a high-rise with hanging gardens.
Rooms with balconies have modern French decor.
The Teeba event venue offers a grand view of the river Nile.
At Night & Day, diners sit near cooking stations where they can watch chefs prepare sushi and teppanyaki.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban location comes with city traffic and noise.
WhataHotel notes this is a mature property that may show signs of age in some areas.
The hotel hosts weddings, conferences and other large events in its banquet and meeting venues.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Semiramis InterContinental Cairo
